messages:
nina.recruit: Quick heads-up / question: manager asked if we can combine two internal promotions into a single packet to speed approvals (same team, different levels). Any reason not to?

omar.comp: You can submit multiple employees in one intake but comp prefers separate evidence packets per person. Helps reviewers avoid conflating justification and band placement.

keisha.hr: Agreed. Operationally we can group them in one exception intake form if they share the same business rationale, but each person needs their own evidence bullets and approver list.

raj.engineering: Manager is trying to avoid duplicate approvals because both promos are tied to the same org restructure. Would grouping slow us down?

omar.comp: If they share the same approver chain (mgr -> dir -> comp), a grouped intake can be routed once, but comp will still evaluate individuals. Grouping only saves the initial intake step, not the review. If timelines are tight, submit separately and tag the packets as related with a single "reorg" reference.

nina.recruit: Bonus Q: one candidate (Person A) is moving from IC to people manager (IC->MGR). Does the promo form differ? Manager says they already started acting as manager for 6 weeks.

keisha.hr: IC->MGR is a role change, so evidence should include: people manager calibration (leadership behaviors), two skip-level endorsements, direct reports' feedback (anonymous summary), and performance evidence. Also include a short onboarding plan for people management training.

raj.engineering: About effective date: manager wants it retro to start of month to align comp cycles and benefits. It's been 20 days. Is that OK?

sam.payroll: 20-day retro is doable in a standard payroll run if submitted before the payroll cutoff and coded correctly. No off-cycle needed. Provide exact effective date and GL code.

keisha.hr: Also check benefits: manager wants the new manager to be eligible for management-level perks (expanded headcount approval, small travel stipend). Benefits effective date should match payroll effective date or benefits team may require a specific enrollment window.

nina.recruit: Another wrinkle: Person B (peer) already has an external offer they disclosed. Manager asks for fast-track and a higher band target. How do we handle counteroffers and promo simultaneity?

omar.comp: Counteroffers and promos are different processes. If you want to match/beat an external offer, treat it as an offer decision (recruiting + hiring manager + comp sign-off) rather than a standard promo acknowledgement. For fairness, document why promo is merit-based vs retention-based. If it's purely retention, label it as retention compensation and run through finance & legal.

keisha.hr: We also escalate any retention/market adjustments to the Head of People for approval if over band midpoint or if it creates a band breach.

raj.engineering: So for Person B we should open an offer packet (recruiting) and separately a promo packet if manager believes promotion is merited?

omar.comp: Yes: 1) Immediate compensation decision (offer/retention) to retain; 2) Separate promo evidence if the manager wants a permanent level change. Note both should reference each other in the tickets.

nina.recruit: Anything else needed for grouping multiple promos?

sam.payroll: Practically: ensure each promo has its own effective date field in the form. If you group them make a parent ticket that lists all employees and link to sub-packets. Payroll needs one-off GL mappings per person.

keisha.hr: Minimum per-person packet checklist (copyable):
``
- Employee name & current role / start date
- Proposed new role & level
- Effective date requested
- 3-line performance summary + scope change examples
- Manager & skip-level endorsements (names)
- Any external offer / retention note (if applicable)
- Approvers: manager, director, comp, finance (if retention), legal (if off-cycle pay)
- Headcount/Req ID if backfill
``

hr-bot: Reminder: for IC->MGR include people-lead calibration checkbox and attach direct report feedback summary. When linking related packets, use tag #reorg-Q1 and tag @omar.comp.

nina.recruit: Perfect. I'll prepare separate one-pagers for each person and link them under a parent intake. We'll flag Person B for an urgent offer flow and Person A for standard promo + manager training plan. Thanks everyone. :pray:
